name: Custom furniture builds
description: Chairs!!!, dining tables, banquettes and casegoods, designed and built to spec. Solid hardwood frames, joinery done by hand. We work from your drawings, your reference photos, or a brief on the back of a napkin.

name: Frame restoration 2
description: If the bones are good, we'll save it. Joint repair, re-gluing, re-doweling, new springs and webbing on traditional pieces. We work on chairs, sofas, antiques and the occasional unicorn. Honest assessment first.

name: Reupholstery 3
description: Strip-to-frame reupholstery on chairs, sofas, dining seats and headboards. Hand-cut fabric, hidden tacking, hand-stitched detail where it matters. The job takes as long as it takes — usually three to five weeks.
